blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture (DA) on Wednesday said it is set to begin implementing farm-to-market road projects after taking over these from the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) last year. READ: 2027 budget: P16B for farm-to-market roads insufficient – DA Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. made the commitment after Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian, during a Senate hearing on the DA’s proposed 2027 budget, asked why the DA had yet to utilize the allocated budget for the projects in 2026.
